mapper.insert: INSERT INTO demand_sandbox_payment (demand_id, purpose, payer_id, amount, out_trade_no, status) VALUES (#{demandId}, #{purpose}, #{payerId}, #{amount}, #{outTradeNo}, 'PENDING') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE demand_id = demand_id
mapper.update: UPDATE demand_sandbox_payment SET status = 'PAID', trade_no = #{tradeNo}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE demand_sandbox_payment SET status = 'CLOSED', updated_at = NOW() WHERE out_trade_no = #{outTradeNo} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE demand_sandbox_payment SET out_trade_no = #{newOutTradeNo}, status = 'PENDING', trade_no = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE demand_id = #{demandId} AND purpose = #{purpose} AND status = 'CLOSED'
